Class SDL_GPUTextureRegion

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<SDL_GPUTextureRegion>
org.lwjgl.sdl.SDL_GPUTextureRegion
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
public class SDL_GPUTextureRegion extends Struct<SDL_GPUTextureRegion> implements NativeResource
struct SDL_GPUTextureRegion {
    SDL_GPUTexture * texture;
    Uint32 mip_level;
    Uint32 layer;
    Uint32 x;
    Uint32 y;
    Uint32 z;
    Uint32 w;
    Uint32 h;
    Uint32 d;
}

    • SDL_GPUTextureRegion

      public SDL_GPUTextureRegion(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a SDL_GPUTextureRegion instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
